correctness.rationale: The assigned theorem fixes the exact normalized Haar coordinate-cube target V_a(c) of Watts–O’Connor–Vala, Eq. (48), with a≤c≤π/2, 0<a<π/2. Differentiating gives ∂cV=(sin2c/π)(B−4C cos2c). Substitution t=tan(a/2), 0<t<1 yields C>0 from t>arctan t; for B−4C, the reduction F(t)=6(1−t²)arctan t+8t³−6t satisfies F′=12t G/(1+t²), G′=2t(3t−arctan t)>0 and F(0)=G(0)=0. Independently reconstructed the derivative identities symbolically, hence B>4C>0 and strict ∂cV>0 on [a,π/2), with the zero derivative only at the boundary endpoint. Precision a=0 and a=π/2 correctly excluded.
